segments.name: Americas
segments.description: Transamerica provides life insurance, retirement and investment solutions in the United States, supported by the WFG affiliated agent network in the US and Canada.
segments.evidence: The first, Transamerica, is a leading provider of life insurance, retirement, and investment solutions in the United States.

segments.name: United Kingdom
segments.description: Aegon UK aims to be a leading digital savings and retirement platform provider serving individuals, advisors and employers in workplace and advisor markets.
segments.evidence: In the United Kingdom , Aegon aims to become a leading digital savings and retirement platform provider in the workplace and advisor markets.

segments.name: International
segments.description: Life insurance serving affluent and high-net-worth individuals mainly in Asia, plus insurance joint ventures in Spain & Portugal, China and Brazil.
segments.evidence: Transamerica Life (Bermuda) provides life insurance solutions to affluent and high-net-worth individuals, mainly in Asia, through offices in Hong Kong and Singapore.

segments.name: Asset Management
segments.description: Aegon Asset Management is a global investment manager serving clients with fixed income, equities, multi-asset and alternative investment solutions.
segments.evidence: Aegon Asset Management (Aegon AM) is a global investment manager providing solutions across fixed income, equities, multi-asset, and alternative investments.

revenueModel.text: Aegon earns revenue from insurance premiums, investment returns, fees and commissions paid by customers and clients of its insurance and asset management businesses.
revenueModel.evidence: Aegon derives its revenue and earnings from insurance premiums, investment returns, fees, and commissions.

changes.text: In 2023, Aegon combined Aegon Nederland with a.s.r. and took a strategic shareholding in the Dutch insurer.
changes.evidence: In the Netherlands, Aegon owns a strategic shareholding in a.s.r. following the 2023 transaction to combine Aegon Nederland with a.s.r.

changes.text: In 2025, Aegon announced it would relocate its head office and legal seat to the US and be renamed Transamerica Inc., and announced a strategic review of the UK.
changes.evidence: Aegon also announced a strategic review of the UK, the further execution of Aegon's strategy to reduce capital employed in Financial Assets through a reinsurance transaction on part of its SGUL block, and a new EUR 400 million share buyback program for 2026.
